spec.purpose: Separate paper sizing sensitivity, not evidence that the strategy edge improved
spec.rules: Same 1000 USDT starting cash, one spot position, 100-USDT/10%-of-equity allocation cap, 2% account drawdown stop, signal prices and fees. The allocation cap can prevent reaching the higher risk ceiling. Higher sizing is simulation only; no real orders or production risk changes.
spec.evaluation: Run both the separate January-June 2026 historical check and the previously inspected July-October diagnostic; report both costs and doubled friction; no selecting the best dates
spec.limitations: Historical depth impact at larger quantities is unavailable; spread/slippage assumptions can understate size-dependent execution costs. Signals remain fixed. The original-risk case is the fair strategy-quality comparison.
